examples.title: RelativeTime
examples.description: Reads a moment on the shared date format in the viewer's zone: "4 min ago", "1 h ago", then "Yesterday, 4:12 PM". The tooltip carries the full dated reading.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { RelativeTime } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const yesterday = new Date(Date.now() - 86_400_000);
</script>

<RelativeTime date={yesterday} tick={false} />

examples.title: Absolute time in Central time
examples.description: format="absolute" always reads the clock ("Today, 10:44 AM", "Sun Nov 1, 4:12 PM") and puts the relative reading in the tooltip. timeZone sets the zone; it defaults to the viewer's.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { RelativeTime } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const updated = new Date(Date.now() - 4 * 60_000);
</script>

<RelativeTime date={updated} format="absolute" timeZone="America/Chicago" tick={false} />
